app_h: Use as an App<small>アプリとして使う</small>
app_install_h: Add to your Home Screen and use it as an app
app_ios_steps: Tap the Share button (a square with an upward arrow) at the bottom of the screen (top right on iPad), then choose "Add to Home Screen".
app_lead: You can put this site on the Home Screen of your phone or computer and use it like an app. Press the 📲 button (next to the language switcher in the header, and in the share box at the bottom of the page).
app_li1: It opens full-screen from the icon, without the address bar.
app_li2: It loads the latest content from the internet each time. With no connection, it shows only pages you have opened before, and says so.
app_li3: It sends no notifications. Visits are counted without cookies and without identifying anyone (see “About Visit Counts” on this page). To stop using it, delete it like any other app.
app_note: Opens full-screen from the icon. Pages you have opened before can be read without a connection. No notifications; visits are counted without identifying anyone.
app_offline: You are offline, so this shows the content from the last time you opened this page.
app_other_steps: From the browser menu (︙ or …), choose "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen".
board_btn: Print a sheet to post or circulate
fb_lead: You can send the people who run this site your thoughts, such as how you use it and what you think of it.
fb_li1: What you send is published on the internet. You need a free GitHub account to send it.
fb_li2: Please do not write anything that identifies a person, such as your name, your address, or your child's name or school.
fb_li3: Opinions and questions about the reorganization plan itself should go to the city's office (“Contacts for the School Reorganization” on the About the Plan page). This site does not pass messages on to the city.
feed_h: Follow by feed (RSS)<small>フィード（RSS）で受け取る</small>
feed_lead: This site publishes new developments as a feed. Add it to a feed reader and new items reach you without opening the site.
feed_li1: What you get: the city’s school reorganization notices, events of the Shinooka-area community councils, eastern district development news, and this site’s updates.
feed_li2: How to subscribe: add the address below to a feed reader. Readers widely used in Japan include Feedly, Inoreader (with a Japanese interface), and NetNewsWire (free) or Reeder for iPhone, iPad and Mac. The format is Atom, which almost any RSS reader can read.
feed_li3: Each item links to the matching corner of this site, not directly to the city’s individual pages.
feed_li4: The feed is in Japanese, whatever display language you choose.

privacy_h: About Visit Counts<small>閲覧数の集計について</small>
privacy_lead: To see how this site is read and to make it easier to use, we count visits in a way that uses no cookies.
privacy_li1: What is counted: the page opened and the display language, which site you came from (the domain only), the screen size, which feature buttons are pressed (share, print, listen, etc.), and whether you came from a QR code.
privacy_li2: What is not counted: your name or email address, anything you type, the grade you choose, or whom you share with. No cookies and no number that identifies you are created.
privacy_li3: Counting uses GoatCounter, an open-source analytics service. No outside script is loaded. As with any connection, your IP address reaches the counting service.
privacy_li4: Nothing is counted when your browser is set to “do not track” (Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control). You can also turn counting off for this device with the button below.
privacy_state_dnt: Your browser is set to “do not track”, so visits are not being counted.
privacy_state_off: Visits from this device are not being counted.
privacy_state_on: Visits from this device are being counted.

site_p: How to introduce this site, use it as an app, follow it by feed (RSS), spread the word, where to send feedback, and how visits are counted.
spread_ask_p: Please do not post photos or names that identify children, schools or individuals. This site is unofficial and does not repost or feature social media posts. You can send feedback about this site through “Send Feedback” below.
spread_ex1: Checked the briefing dates on #学校再編ナビ and added them to my phone's calendar. #桃花台 #篠岡地区
spread_ex2: You can read about the school reorganization in Portuguese and English too, so you can send it to families with roots abroad. #学校再編ナビ #小牧 #小牧市東部
spread_ex3: Printed “Latest Updates” as a one-page circular and passed it around our children's group. #学校再編ナビ #桃花台
spread_h: Spread the Word<small>使い方を広める・応援する</small>
spread_lead: When you post about how you use this site or what you think of it, please add these hashtags. When posts gather under the same tags, people in the area can find the information more easily.
spread_tags_note: Use #学校再編ナビ (the site's name) for how you use the site and what you think of it, and the place-name tags to reach people following local topics. Please keep the tags in Japanese as they are.
spread_use1: Choose a language before sharing, and the other person opens the page in that language too (12 languages)
spread_use2: Print “Latest Updates” as a one-page A4 circular for your neighborhood association or children's group
spread_use3: Put a page's QR code on a notice board or a flyer
spread_use4: Choose your child's grade and send the schedule to parents of the same grade, showing what happens in which school year
spread_use5: Put events into your phone's calendar with “📅 Add to calendar”
spread_use6: Read together with your child using “🔊 Listen” (and, in Japanese, the kids' mode)
spread_use7: Put it on your home screen like an app, and follow new updates with the feed
